records.name: PostHog
records.action: Scroll the window and open Pricing.
records.outcome: The app window scrolled 935 CSS px and Pricing showed free limits in the same shell.
records.transfer: Keep the plain route to cost and limits through a strong branded shell.
records.prediction: A visitor can name the billing unit and locate the next action at 390 px.
records.falsifier: Ask a first-time visitor to explain the free allowance before picking a plan.

records.name: WWF Blue Corridors
records.action: Open Layers and switch Globe to Flat (Static).
records.outcome: The projection changed. The visible region explanations and selected-view affordance remained.
records.transfer: Keep the selected region and its explanation anchored as the visual state changes.
records.prediction: Both the selected water level and which crossings close are in one 390 px viewport.
records.falsifier: Switch 6 m to 2 m and check that only the path remains closed in the list and at its place on the scene.

records.name: Butterfly Meadow
records.action: Focus Still pond and press Enter.
records.outcome: The selected thumbnail, scene, heading and caption changed to Still pond.
records.transfer: Let a clear state choice change the artwork and its reading together.

records.name: Pentagram Archive
records.action: Open the archive and scroll the filtered gallery.
records.outcome: The welcome panel disappeared. Results rendered with the selected swatch visible and the document scrolled 680 CSS px.
records.transfer: Let real result imagery carry the visual identity while the filter stays recognizable.
records.prediction: At 390 px, filtered results remain recognizable without stretching or inventing thumbnails.
records.falsifier: Scroll results, return to the filter, and identify which constraint is active.

records.name: Jamb
records.action: Scroll the category page and open the Marble collection.
records.outcome: The scroll moved 573 CSS px, exposing the photographed categories. Marble opened its own catalog path.
records.transfer: Use consistently lit product imagery to make material categories distinct. Keep category names explicit.
records.prediction: A shopper can choose marble or stone from the first category group at 390 px.
records.falsifier: Ask the shopper to find the marble collection without relying on the photography alone.
